page_reviews.finding: Title and subtitle describe a calibrated compatibility/persistence resource. Abstract separates researcher controls from Gemma outcomes. Lineage definition correctly treats files and repetitions as dependent observations. Figure 1 is legible and consistent with the workflow.

Grouped eight-lineage table is legible. The 17/65 files, H/F/R 131/53/68 and 99/252 fresh-installation base score agree with the saved controls; fixed and allowed-file reference repairs each pass 252/252. Caption discloses process-dependent dtype partial counts. Pseudocode is explicitly a simplification, and its mutation and fresh-process reload claims are accurate.

Collision formula uses separate process encoders E_p and E_q. The 267-byte equality is a targeted witness, not an estimated frequency. Alternative repair scope is bounded to the stated native-pandas numeric universe. Empty Interval and vacuous inference explanation correctly retains pre-existing information loss. Figure 2 distinguishes admissible and literal-reference judgments.

All 32 attempt cells and four accepted outcomes remain visible. Completion is separated from semantic acceptance, overlapping context-limit flags are explained, and deployment confounds and additional service recovery are disclosed. Tool-budget limitations are expressed as request bytes rather than nominal model context capacity. New tool-friction and lifecycle examples match frozen trajectories and avoid interpreting these failures as general model inability.
Upstream comparator reports zero added discrimination. Release verification is scoped to the same ARM host. Resource limitations remain explicit.
All 15 references are legible with consistent citation numbering; Gröninger is correctly rendered. Scientific Agent Skills remains a software acknowledgment rather than substantive related work.

contract_example.pseudocode_judgment: Faithful simplified control flow; fresh_process is explicitly a new interpreter. Omissions such as del a, serialization options, subprocess setup and full snapshot fields do not make this illustrative code a complete executable verifier.

limitations: Eight curated public defect lineages across six projects are a small, targeted resource, not a representative bug population.
Four accepted model patches provide bounded baseline evidence; they do not establish superiority of a model, prompting technique or evaluator.
Known serialization ambiguity and upstream fixes are precedents; novelty is the packaged contracts, reproducibility and multi-solution calibration.
The general alternative-repair claim is limited to the stated native-pandas numeric universe; arbitrary extension dtypes are not established.
Anonymous attribution, owner identity, release URL and authorization to publish remain owner-side publication matters, not local manuscript blockers.

award_assessment.basis: The present manuscript now makes the resource usable and assessable: authentic historical artifacts, bounded editable repairs, complete lifecycle contracts, frozen reproducible controls, a calibrated multi-solution example and transparent negative comparisons. The concrete joblib example and trajectory analysis make the contribution clearer than engineering verification alone.
award_assessment.remaining_competitive_risk: Novelty remains modest and curation is small. This is a defensible resource submission, not evidence of a new general testing method or a prediction of an award.

overall: Current six-page manuscript is scientifically bounded, materially clearer and internally consistent. No required correction was identified in this review.
